scope: Aggregate all 27 fixed SDK builds and require complete 27-receipt / 53-output inventory before exact PCM/API comparisons; current runtime assets are unchanged.

startingPoint.scope: All27 aggregate checker, receipt validation, fresh-checkout DX7 guard and CI configuration. No core/default/runtime output changes.

perArtifact.frameCountScope: Both builds: all main bodies+127-frame continuation probes including selected reset/replays. Bounded chip/Engine positives and actual Player render-ahead/seek-prefix generation are separate components. Engine delegates directly to the chip; those native output frames and Player delivered/discarded frames are not added twice.

Both builds: mono scenario bodies, 257-frame continuation probes, selected panic/reprogram replays and wrapper/raw-ABI control output. Each Float32 element is one mono output frame. Internal block prefetch and unreturned core work are not counted.

Wrapper positives and actual Player generation separate; native ticks/internal Engine calls and delivered Player frames notaddedtwice.

Both actual builds: main complete768-frame bodies+97-frame continuation probes; selected regular reset/replays repeat complete bodies+probes. record.frameCountCaveat: DX7 mono and other per-core stereo/native counters remain separate; two runs are repeat evidence, not doubled unique coverage.

limits: Exact synchronous Node/WASM PCM and API parity, not browser/AudioWorklet timing or physical listening.
Existing mixed-engine checks use committed partner-chip builds; each comparison replaces one core at a time.
DX7 frame counts are mono; other checker counters retain their original units and are not combined.
No package/archive build, publish, remote CI dispatch or Native/Tauri execution.
remaining: Run or inspect the new remote CI workflow when requested; no individual SDK WASM migration remains. SPC WebKit close during initialization remains a separate open issue.
